title: Algebraic Degree of Network Games: Balanced Factors and Strategy Scaling
summary: The algebraic degree of a network game is the generic number of isolated complex-torus solutions of its polynomial indifference system. We recast the classical semi-mixed coefficient formula as an edge-marked player-level polynomial whose monomials are balanced directed multigraphs with prescribed in- and out-degrees.
